storage.built_in: 96 TB on-board storage (78 TB usable with RAID 5); 2 x 240 GB SSD OS drives

features: 1 x dedicated service port; 2 x Mini-SAS HD ports for CSP-10EXT storage expansion (up to 384 TB external)
IP camera support: Costar DirectNET, AV Costar ConteraIP, CostarHD RISE, ONVIF Profile S, Axis, Panasonic (A&E spec adds Basler, Mobotix, Pelco, Sony, 360 Vision, RTP/RTSP)
Microsoft Windows Server 2016 for Embedded Systems; Intel Xeon Silver 4210; 8 GB memory
notes: Datasheet gives 96 TB storage; the A&E spec gives max 128 TB with 8 x 3.5" SAS/SATA HDDs.
Datasheet gives consumption 2 x 750 W; A&E spec gives 750 W. Power consumption left out.
Datasheet gives width 482 mm; A&E spec gives 434.0 mm and states its dimensions exclude the bezel. Dimensions left out; both give height 86.8 mm and depth 737.5 mm.
A&E spec states the unit has no dedicated audio port.
